title: PI plan — tranche 6 (retrospective, 2026-11-27)
body:
# PI plan — tranche 6

## Objectives

O1 S06a is retired by recorded supersession with a green receipt and no build artefacts. O2
S06b's agent interface is accepted: one real agent task creates a project, reads its progress,
answers an approval and closes it with `decided_by_kind='agent'`, and no
`nonagenticai_mcp_server` is in the path. O3 S10's copilot/AG-UI surface is accepted. O4 S11's
procedures and SOPs are accepted. O5 T19F's decision-forum governance gate is accepted: a
reviewed policy asset publishes a new immutable `meeting_type` version while an in-flight
meeting keeps its pinned version; a board subject decision is taken in a sitting whose
qualifying seats each write one `approval_decision` with `via='meeting'`; a cadence row
materialises exactly one meeting; the direct board path is unchanged. O6 the tranche review
decides continue or pause on the evidence.

## Plan

S06a is a record retirement, not a build: its plan was superseded by S06b on 2026-11-08 and
nothing there is to be built. The operative order is S06a, S06b, S10, S11, T19F. S06b is the
conveyor's own `/mcp` agent interface and the control plane S10 and S11 read; T19F closes the
tranche with its live decision-forum gate.

## WSJF order

S06b (10/13/8/8), S10 (9/8/8/9), S11 (8/7/7/8), T19F (9/6/10/14), S06a (5/8/5/1). S06a is
first as the record retirement; the build work starts at S06b because it is the interface and
control plane the other members read.

## Capacity and WIP

Six read/audit agents, one build and one live-record writer; two open batches and one open card
per writer.

## Evidence

Programme `01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac`, tranche `01a1e9e1-07d3-75d3-8c99-4002d5bfe8f7`, the refinement `docs/evidence/rework/tranche-6/refinement-wsjf.json`,
and the public-tree de-identification and retention record at `docs/evidence/rework/retention-2026-11-27.json`.

## Dependencies

S10 and S11 depend on S06b's agent interface; T19F depends on T19, T17, T9, T10 and P0; S06a is
superseded by S06b. Every member's receipt is green and fresh at the tranche snapshot before the
review.

## Backlog refinement

The tranche-6 refinement cadence `01a21c62-6a43-7d17-9d5b-836ad1801e45` carries the WSJF inputs and the reordered
backlog; this plan's order follows it.
